title: Curated Modern Apartment in Historic Neighborhood
description:
Welcome to a pristine retreat nestled in Germantown — a historic neighborhood located in the heart of Nashville. Close to downtown and in walking distance to some of the city's best restaurants, this space is perfect for a business trip, couple's getaway, or quick spell in our sweet city.

The space
The apartment is located on the ground floor of a beautiful, historic home. It's been freshly renovated with modern fixtures and beautiful furnishings so you can enjoy the charm of the neighborhood with the convenience of modern day life. You have your own private entrance and designated parking.
